Record `proof ui …` and `proof snap` commands into a flow.

```sh
proof record <subcommand>
```

proof record start
proof ui tap --id onboarding.skip      (each successful action is recorded)
proof snap home
proof record stop login                saves ~/.proof/flows/<repo>/login.flow

**Subcommands:** [`start`](#proof-record-start) · [`stop`](#proof-record-stop) · [`status`](#proof-record-status) · [`undo`](#proof-record-undo) · [`discard`](#proof-record-discard)

## proof record start

```sh
proof record start [--json]
```

**JSON output** (`--json`):

- [`MessageReport`](../../json-output/#messagereport)

## proof record stop

Stop and save the recording as a flow.

```sh
proof record stop [--json] <name> [--force]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `<name>` | Flow name. **Required.** |
| `--force` | Overwrite an existing flow. |

**JSON output** (`--json`):

- [`MessageReport`](../../json-output/#messagereport)

## proof record status

```sh
proof record status [--json]
```

**JSON output** (`--json`):

- [`MessageReport`](../../json-output/#messagereport)

## proof record undo

Drop the last recorded step(s).

```sh
proof record undo [--json] [<count>]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `<count>` | Default: `1`. |

**JSON output** (`--json`):

- [`MessageReport`](../../json-output/#messagereport)

